title: Inter SB celebrate 1 Liga title
description: FINALBlue Wings 2 - Inter SB 46-80 Inter SB dominated down low during the game scoring 44 of its points in the paint compared to Blue Wings 2's 22. They outrebounded Blue Wings 2 42-31 including 28 on the defensive glass. Inter SB brought some defensive toughness making 7 blocks. Worth to mention a great performance of the former international power forward Maros Golian (206-2007) who helped to win the game recording a double-double by scoring 28 points, 18 rebounds and 4 blocks (on 11-of-14 shooting from the field). point guard Bruno Randuska (191-2008) contributed with 12 points, 5 rebounds and 4 assists for the winners. Four Inter SB players scored in double figures. Guard Andrej Nahlik (192-2006) answered with 10 points and 6 rebounds and forward Adam Galko (205-2004) added 6 points and 6 rebounds in the effort for Blue Wings 2. The winner was already known earlier in the game, so…

title: Kosice Wolves claim 1Liga title
description: Kosice Wolves celebrated 1Liga title. They outscored Academic Zilina 103-85 in the championship game today. Adam Moncek (190-G-2000) tallied 28 points, 11 rebounds and 11 assists to lead the champions. Kosice Wolves established a 47-36 halftime lead. They poured in 56 points in the second half and rallied to the win. Dmytro Sokolovskyi (190-PG-2004) finished with 26 points for the winners. Simon Duris (183-PG-1998) answered with 27 points, 11 assists and 9 rebounds for Academic Zilina.

title: Academic Zilina clinch 1. liga 2023/24 title
description: Academic Zilina clinched 1. liga 2023/24 title. They overcame TSM Slavia Young Men Zilina 89-78 in the decisive game. Robert Rozanek (191-G-1996) stepped up with 30 points and Simon Turza (192-G-2000) nailed 22. Simon Duris (183-PG-1998) followed them with 9 points in the winning effort. Milan Ziak (190-PG-1988) answered with 27 points in the losing effort.
imageCaption: Academic Zilina clinch 1. liga 2023/24 title (Photo: slovakbasket.sk)

title: Nitra win 1 Liga title
description: Nitra have won 1 Liga title and therefore gained the right to join SBL next season. Nitra crushed Academic Zilina 106-56 in the title game. Slovakia Povazska Bystrica earned the third position. They overcame Isra Svit U23 86-81 in the consolation final.

title: BKM SPU Nitra won 1Liga
description: BKM SPU Nitra won the regular season of 1Liga with the best record 9-2. Together with SBK JUNIOR PATRIOTI U23 Levice and Academic ZU Zilina they will now participate in Relegation phase of Nike SBL for the spot in top league in 2022/2023 season.
